name: Draggable Coin Spinner
description: A 3D coin rendered from a preloaded image sequence on a canvas that auto-spins and can be dragged horizontally to rotate, with inertia throw and a caption.
contents: Canvas showing the coin frame sequence
Loading bar shown while frames preload
behavior: Preloads all frames then fades in the caption
Auto-plays the frame sequence in a loop
Horizontal drag scrubs frames with optional inertia throw
Uses lower drag resistance on mobile user agents

props.name: description
props.default: Drag horizontally to spin the coin

editableByProps: Frame image source, count, extension and padding
Coin size, spin speed and drag/inertia feel

needsCodeEdit.change: Change coin placement inside the canvas

needsCodeEdit.where: coinLoader keyframes in the style block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Frame images must be a numbered sequence from 0 to frameCount
